witness.shape: three-block body entered from outside at its middle block

speed_method: interleaved min-of-N, 13 samples per arm, alternating arm order, two discarded warmups. scripts.pipeline.timeit runs all OFF samples then all ON samples, which on this box reported -31.94% for a pass that cannot make anything faster - the first arm pays every cold cost. The number above is the ON arm on a goto-heavy function (8 probe edges); the shipped default is off, where the pass returns before building any graph.

premise_measurement.corpus: 1483 paired O2 / O2-noinline functions (coreutils/tr, coreutils/ls, bzip2, gzip, tar)
premise_measurement.note: goto density does NOT separate inlined from non-inlined code; the function-level association is a size effect. This bounds the claim and is why the pass reports the structural fact under the goto rather than the goto.

sweep.reason: report-only; no p-code and no structured node is touched, so off is byte-identical and the set of functions whose C changes with no option supplied is empty. Both parity gates confirm it (675/675 and 443/443 unchanged).
